<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_Chainsaw" targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/chainsaw">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_OrderProperties" name="Chainsaw properties"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PartsOrder" name="Parts order"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Parts" name="Ordered parts"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ProductionUpdate" name="Production update"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_FirstChainsaw" name="First chainsaw"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_CustomerFeedback" name="Customer feedback"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Chainsaw">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Producer" name="Chainsaw producer" processRef="Process_Chainsaw"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Customer" name="Customer"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_OnlineSources" name="Online parts sources"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Properties" name="Provide chainsaw properties" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="StartEvent_Properties" messageRef="Message_OrderProperties"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_PartsOrder" name="Order parts" sourceRef="Task_OrderParts" targetRef="Participant_OnlineSources" messageRef="Message_PartsOrder"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Parts" name="Parts arrive" sourceRef="Participant_OnlineSources" targetRef="Task_ReceiveParts" messageRef="Message_Parts"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Updates" name="Send production updates" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdates" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_ProductionUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_FirstChainsaw" name="Send first chainsaw" sourceRef="Task_SendFirst" targetRef="Participant_Customer" messageRef="Message_FirstChainsaw"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Feedback" name="Provide feedback" sourceRef="Participant_Customer" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFeedback" messageRef="Message_CustomerFeedback"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Chainsaw" name="Chainsaw" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Properties" name="Customer provides chainsaw properties">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Properties" messageRef="Message_OrderProperties"/>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_OrderParts" name="Order parts from various online sources in parallel" messageRef="Message_PartsOrder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveParts" name="Receive all ordered parts" messageRef="Message_Parts">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:manualTask id="Task_InspectParts" name="Manually inspect all parts">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_4</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:manualTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ProductionSplit" name="Produce first saw and send updates">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_4</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_5</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_6</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_AssembleFirst" name="Assemble parts into the first chainsaw">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_5</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_7</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendUpdates" name="Send regular production updates" messageRef="Message_ProductionUpdate">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_6</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_8</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_ProductionJoin" name="First chainsaw produced and updates sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_7</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_8</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_9</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendFirst" name="Send the first chainsaw to the customer" messageRef="Message_FirstChainsaw">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_9</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_10</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_ReceiveFeedback" name="Receive customer feedback" messageRef="Message_CustomerFeedback">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_10</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_11</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CustomerLikes" name="Does the customer like the first chainsaw?" default="Flow_NotApproved">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_11</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Approved</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_NotApproved</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_ProduceRest" name="Produce the rest of the order">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Approved</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_12</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_OrderProduced" name="Rest of order produced">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_12</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_NotApproved" name="Order not continued">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_NotApproved</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_1" sourceRef="StartEvent_Properties" targetRef="Task_OrderParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_2" sourceRef="Task_OrderParts" targetRef="Task_ReceiveParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_3" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveParts" targetRef="Task_InspectParts"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_4" sourceRef="Task_InspectParts" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_5" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionSplit" targetRef="Task_AssembleFirst"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_6" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionSplit" targetRef="Task_SendUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_7" sourceRef="Task_AssembleFirst" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_8" sourceRef="Task_SendUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_ProductionJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_9" sourceRef="Gateway_ProductionJoin" targetRef="Task_SendFirst"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_10" sourceRef="Task_SendFirst" targetRef="Task_ReceiveFeedback"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_11" sourceRef="Task_ReceiveFeedback" targetRef="Gateway_CustomerLikes"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Approved" name="Customer likes it" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerLikes" targetRef="Task_ProduceRest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">customer likes the first chainsaw</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotApproved" name="Otherwise" sourceRef="Gateway_CustomerLikes" targetRef="EndEvent_NotApproved"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_12" sourceRef="Task_ProduceRest" targetRef="EndEvent_OrderProduced"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
